corrected_test_issues: The first PG full race run reached DATABASE_URL validation before the invalid-password sentinel. The test now supplies a dummy database URL; no production change was necessary.
The first offline-Kafka executable check expected an internal error string suppressed by main. It now checks the public startup failure plus exit/time bounds and no schema creation.
The initial embedded-asset reference test treated a cache-busting query as part of the filename. It now uses URL.Path; private fixture was excluded in both branches.

preliminary_rehearsal_fixtures.problem: macOS temporary path used a symlinked parent
preliminary_rehearsal_fixtures.resolution: canonical physical path; store correctly refused initial startup

preliminary_rehearsal_fixtures.problem: route-selected VPN IP was unreachable from local generator
preliminary_rehearsal_fixtures.resolution: explicit reachable physical interface IPv4; bounded connectivity check

postgres_integration: Full race suite uses real local PostgreSQL with isolated test schemas. Opt-in Kafka failure suites were not repeated; both real HTTP rehearsals and offline-Kafka startup check are separate.
runtime_scope: Darwin binaries executed. Linux amd64/arm64 cross-built only. No external TLS/SASL, physical-host failure or 1.7M HTTP/s test.
browser_scope: Embedded asset contents unchanged; HTTP assets, admin authentication, lifecycle and restart tested. Browser JS execution suite was not repeated.
